```{r, load and prep data}

master_tier5 <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"), "master_tier5.csv")
)

master_tier5_clean <- master_tier5 %>%
    filter(Flux > 0, 
         Dist != 48) %>%
  mutate(
    Study.Phase = factor(Study.Phase, levels = paste0("M", 1:12)),
    Site = factor(Site, levels = c("GiantMarsh", "SanPablo", "Buck'sLanding", "CorteMadera")),
    Tran = factor(Tran),
    marsh_edge_type = as.factor(marsh_edge_type),
    marsh_orientation = as.factor(marsh_orientation), 
    Month = factor(
      Month, levels = c("Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec",
                                       "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun")), 
    Phen_Period = factor(
      Phen_Period,
      levels = c("Late_Dry\n(Months 1-3)", "Tran\n(Months 4-6)",
                 "Wet\n(Months 7-9)", "Growth\n(Months 10-12)")
  )
)



```

## Flux over calendar date

```{r, rq1 time}

summary_df <- master_tier5_clean %>%
  group_by(Site, Tran, Month) %>%
  summarise(median_flux = median(Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
            q25 = quantile(Flux, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
            q75 = quantile(Flux, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

rq1_time_trend = ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Month, y = median_flux, color = Tran, fill = Tran)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Site, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = transect_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = transect_colors) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(x = "Date Removed from Field", y = expression(Median~Flux~(g/m^2/day)),
       color = "Transect", fill = "Transect") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 18))
rq1_time_trend

ggsave(file.path(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"), "rq1_time_trend.png"),
       plot = rq1_time_trend,
       width = 13.33,
       height = 7.5,
       dpi = 300,
       limitsize = FALSE)

rq1_time = ggplot(master_tier5_clean, aes(x = Month, y = Flux, color = Tran, fill = Tran)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = interaction(Month, Tran)), 
               alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA, 
               position = position_dodge(width = 6)) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 1.5, dodge.width = 6),
              size = 0.8, alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~Site, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(values = transect_colors)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(values = transect_colors)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(x = "Date Removed from Field", y = expression(Flux~(g/m^2/day)),
       color = "Transect", fill = "Transect") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
rq1_time

ggsave(file.path(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"), "rq1_time.png"),
       plot = rq1_time,
       width = 13.33,
       height = 7.5,
       dpi = 300,
       limitsize = FALSE)

```

```{r, aggregate per Study.Phase-Site}

total_summary <- master_tier5_clean %>%
  group_by(Site, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = mean(Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sd(Flux, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mean_month_site = ggplot(total_summary, aes(x = Month, y = mean_flux, group = Site, color = Site)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_flux - se_flux, ymax = mean_flux + se_flux), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(site_colors)) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Majority Month Deployed", y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^2/day))) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
mean_month_site

ggsave("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\images\\rq_1\\mean_month_site.png", 
       plot = mean_month_site, 
       width = 8, 
       height = 5, 
       dpi = 300,
       limitsize = FALSE)
```

```{r, Study Phase by marsh group and transect}

phase_compare <- master_tier5_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Marsh_Group = case_when(
      Site %in% c("SanPablo", "GiantMarsh") ~ "San Pablo + Giant Marsh",
      Site %in% c("Buck'sLanding", "CorteMadera") ~ "Buck's Landing + Corte Madera",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Marsh_Group)) %>%
  group_by(Marsh_Group, Site, Tran, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = mean(Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sd(Flux, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

phase_compare_grouped <- phase_compare %>%
  group_by(Marsh_Group, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = weighted.mean(mean_flux, n, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sqrt(sum(se_flux^2 * n^2, na.rm = TRUE)) / sum(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(phase_compare_grouped, aes(x = Month, y = mean_flux, color = Marsh_Group, group = Marsh_Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_flux - se_flux, ymax = mean_flux + se_flux), width = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Majority Month Deployed", y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^2/day)), color = "Marsh Group")

mean_month = ggplot(phase_compare, aes(x = Month, y = mean_flux, color = Tran, group = Tran)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(transect_colors)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_flux - se_flux, ymax = mean_flux + se_flux), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Month Majority Deployment", y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^2/day)), color = "Transect") + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
mean_month

ggsave("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\images\\rq_1\\mean_month.png", 
       plot = mean_month, 
       width = 8, 
       height = 5, 
       dpi = 300,
       limitsize = FALSE)
```

```{r, Study Phase by distance}

transect_summary2 <- master_tier5_clean %>%
  mutate(Flux_zeroed = ifelse(Flux < 0, 0, Flux)) %>%
  filter(Dist %in% c(0.5, 2, 6, 12, 18, 24)) %>%
  mutate(Dist = factor(Dist, levels = c(0.5, 2, 6, 12, 18, 24))) %>%
  group_by(Dist, Site, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = mean(Flux_zeroed, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sd(Flux_zeroed, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dist_month <- ggplot(transect_summary2, aes(x = Month, y = mean_flux, color = Site, group = Site)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_flux - se_flux, 0.001), ymax = mean_flux + se_flux),
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5) +
```

## Phenological period

```{r, phen period plots}

phen_summary <- master_tier5_clean %>%
  mutate(Flux_zeroed = ifelse(Flux < 0, 0.001, Flux)) %>%
  group_by(Phen_Period, Site) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = mean(Flux_zeroed, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sd(Flux_zeroed, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(phen_summary, aes(x = Phen_Period, y = mean_flux, color = Site, group = Site)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_flux - se_flux, 0.001), ymax = mean_flux + se_flux), width = 0.2) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Mean Flux by Phenological Period", subtitle = "Log-scaled y-axis",
       x = "Phenological Period", y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^2/day)), color = "Site")

phen_summary_no_giant <- master_tier5_clean %>%
  filter(Site != "GiantMarsh") %>%
  mutate(Flux_zeroed = ifelse(Flux < 0, 0, Flux)) %>%
  group_by(Phen_Period, Site) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = mean(Flux_zeroed, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sd(Flux_zeroed, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(phen_summary_no_giant, aes(x = Phen_Period, y = mean_flux, color = Site, group = Site)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_flux - se_flux, ymax = mean_flux + se_flux), width = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Mean Flux by Phenological Period", subtitle = "GiantMarsh removed",
       x = "Phenological Period", y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^2/day)), color = "Site")

ggplot(phen_summary, aes(x = Phen_Period, y = mean_flux, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_flux - se_flux, ymax = mean_flux + se_flux), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Mean Flux by Phenological Period", x = "Phenological Period", y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^2/day)))
```

```{r, temporal marsh models}

edge_time_model <- lmer(
  Flux ~ marsh_edge_type * Month + (1|Site),
  data = master_tier5_clean
)
summary(edge_time_model)
anova(edge_time_model)

```

```{r}
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)

emm_edge_time <- emmeans(edge_time_model, ~ marsh_edge_type * Month)
emm_edge_time_df <- as.data.frame(emm_edge_time)

emm = ggplot(emm_edge_time_df, aes(x = Month, y = emmean, color = marsh_edge_type, group = marsh_edge_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
  labs(
    title = str_wrap("Estimated Marginal Means of Flux by Marsh Edge Type Across Month within 2025-2026", width = 40),
    y = "Estimated Flux", x = "Majority Month Deployed", color = "Edge Type"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = marsh_edge_colors) + 
 theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
